description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore component related to onboarding state management in an iOS application. It includes test cases for presenting onboarding screens, persistence of onboarding modes, first run intro visibility, and reset functionality.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for OnboardingStateStore functionalities like presentation, persistence, and reset.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding is presented when the application is first launched and the gateway server name is nil.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding is not presented when the application is connected to a gateway.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Verifies that marking onboarding as complete correctly persists the mode and influences onboarding presentation.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Ensures the first run intro is visible initially and that its state is persisted after being marked seen.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Checks that resetting onboarding state clears completion and first run intro flags, causing onboarding to be presented again.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a unique UserDefaults suite for testing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the UserDefaults state for the test suite by removing its persistent domain.
